name: Investment Advisory Policy Committee Meeting
minutes_text:
July 14, 2017

  ACTION MEMO
  OF THE
  INVESTMENT POLICY ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  OF THE
  CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA

CALL TO ORDER

Committee Members Chairwoman Lozzi, Sagolla, Ying, and Sherwood.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT
on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Investment Policy Advisory
Committee this afternoon on matters presented under this section.

  1. None.

OLD BUSINESS

1. None.

  Received and filed.

NEW BUSINESS

1. Review goals of the Committee.

  Investment Policy Advisory Committee Member Sagolla moved (2nd by Committee
  Member Ying) to approved staff recommendation to define the mandate of the Committee
  as well as define what success would be for the Committee.

2. Review current Investment Policy.
  • Discuss purpose and content of policy in relation to State requirements/limits for
  municipal investments
  • Discuss updates for recommendation to the City Council.

  Investment Policy Advisory Committee Chair Member Lozzi recommended and approved
  by Committee Member Ying,(2nd by Committee Member Sagolla) to review and compare
  differences between the California State Investment policy and Palos Verdes Estates
  Investment policy and prepare an updated June 30, 2017 Investment Policy for the current
  fiscal year at the September 12, 2017 City Council meeting.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on September 12, 2017.
 3. Review current cash and investment portfolio.
  • Discuss updates for portfolio

  No action taken. Committee provided direction to staff to consider topic in future
  discussions regarding issue of long term cash flow requirements.

4. Review and discuss Broker Agreements.

  No action taken. Committee provided direction to staff to consider topic in future
  discussions regarding performance of investment brokers.

5. Identify topics for discussion at future meetings.

  Investment Policy Advisory Committee Chair Member Lozzi recommended and approved
  by Committee Member Ying,(2nd by Committee Member Sagolla) to update the City’s
  Investment Policy, including timing of report, define the mandate/success of the
  Committee as envisioned by the City Council, establish a target for cash operating
  balances, review bank service fees, look into the viability of utilizing Los Angeles County
  Pooled Funds and obtain current California Investment Policy.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATION

The following items of correspondence are submitted to the Investment Policy Advisory
Committee for information.

6. None

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM STAFF/COMMITTEE

7. Staff Items of Information for the Committee.

  None

ADJOURNMENT TO WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 24, 2017, 10:00 A.M. IN COUNCIL
CHAMBERS OF CITY HALL.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on September 12, 2017.
